screen.reason: This is a clinical trial protocol evaluating the real-world deployment and clinical efficacy of an AI-powered mHealth tool (FiberMore, utilizing GPT-4o for photo logging and chatbot guidance) compared to a control group, but it evaluates the overall intervention rather than comparing specific guardrails or deployment practices.
